== Patch 1.2.15 ==
* Bulwark and Authority proven warrior spellbooks are now unbound.
* The Darus need your help! They are preparing for the Day of Beginnings and need resources to make it a success.
* Each faction will receive a different resource pile to contribute to, with 3 stages: Wheat for a Cake, Paper to wrap gifts, and Gunpowder to make fireworks. Once all stages are completed, players can spend 10 labor to complete the final daily quest.
* You'll be able to contribute every 10 hours. Each stage will have a daily quest associated gifting you with Loyalty Tokens. The first faction to reach stage 3 will be able to benefit from the quest granting the most loyalty!
* Lastly, the resource pile will also grant you a buff for 3 hours when interacting with it once stages are completed, getting stronger with each tier: Get to the final stage fast to get the best buff!
* Rajani has been increased to 11.5 m/s
* Black Arrow has been increased to 11.5 m/s
* Thunder Dash has been increased to 11.5 m/s
* The chest issue with the search bar has been fixed
